text:
An action-packed European slate features several upcoming fixtures where the model sees surprising potential in underdogs. While Bet365 remains slightly more accurate overall across test seasons, sharp disagreements between the market and the model offer plenty of fixtures worth a closer look.

The biggest difference this week comes in Serie A, where the model gives Cagliari a 27.5% chance at Lazio compared to Bet365's 13.3% assessment at odds of 7.5. In La Liga, Santander hosting Real Madrid reveals another split: the model gives Santander a 19.3% win chance at odds of 10.0, while the market gives them just a 10.0% probability. Other notable shifts include Levante against Atletico Madrid, where the model sees a 30.3% home win chance at odds of 5.25 versus Bet365's 19.1%, and Crystal Palace's trip to Tottenham, rated at a 28.1% away win chance at odds of 5.5 compared to the market's 18.2%. Meanwhile, Manchester United's visit to Chelsea sees the model give United a 34.8% chance at odds of 4.1, well above Bet365's 24.4%.

Reviewing the latest played matches, evaluating performance via log loss—where lower numbers indicate higher accuracy—shows a competitive round. In Serie A, the model notched a standout success by backing Inter with a 91.5% win chance over Venezia, yielding a superior log loss of 0.089 compared to Bet365's 0.359. The model also bested the market in Ligue 1 by cleanly projecting Lens to beat Paris FC. However, shock results tripped up predictions across the continent, most notably Borussia Monchengladbach's away win at Stuttgart and Genoa defeating Juventus, both of which caught the model and bookmakers off guard.
